abstract: This report describes a case of teratoma with retroperitoneal lymph nodes involved with malignant teratoma (enteric adenocarcinoma) after extensive chemotherapy for the original testicular cancer. A 18-year-old man with a mixed cell tumor (embryonal carcinoma+teratoma+yolk sac tumor) received three courses of VAB-6 chemotherapy for bulky mass following inguinal orchiectomy. He was referred to Tochigi Cancer Center for treatment of a residual mass. He was treated with resection of the mass combined with left nephrectomy due to severe adhesion and pathological diagnosis of the resected lymph node was mature teratoma with a massive necrotic tissue. Two courses of BEP chemotherapy were given to the patient following the surgery. Six months after completion of chemotherapy, a retroperitoneal mass of 1.5 cm in diameter, was detected by CT scan. Standard retroperitoneal lymph node dissection was performed and the pathological diagnosis of the lymph node was teratoma with malignant transformation containing enteric adenocarcinoma. Teratomatous portion of the primary lesion was precisely re-examined and adenocarcinoma, similar histology to the retroperitoneal mass, was identified. He received two courses of EAP chemotherapy (Cis-platin+etoposide+doxorubicin) as an adjuvant chemotherapy following the surgery and he is alive with no evidence of recurrence for 21 months. Presence of non germ cell malignancy after chemotherapy in testicular cancer has been regarded as a rare phenomenon. Flow cytometric DNA analyses of both embryonal carcinoma and teratoma in the primary lesion, mature teratoma and teratoma with malignant transformation of the retroperitoneal lymph node disclosed that these tumors were all aneuploid tumors.(ABSTRACT TRUNCATED AT 250 WORDS)
abstract_ja: 化学療法後の精巣奇形腫の後腹膜リンパ節に悪性奇形腫(腸型腺癌)を伴った1例を報告する。症例は18歳男性で、精巣の混合細胞腫瘍(胎児性癌+奇形腫+卵黄嚢腫瘍)と診断された。鼠径部精巣摘除術の後、巨大腫瘤に対しVAB-6化学療法を3コース受けた。残存腫瘤の治療のため当センターに紹介された。癒着が強かったため、腫瘤切除と左腎摘除を併施した。切除したリンパ節の病理診断は、壊死組織を伴う成熟奇形腫であった。手術後にBEP化学療法を2コース施行した。化学療法終了から6か月後、CTで直径1.5cmの後腹膜腫瘤が検出された。標準的な後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行し、病理診断は腸型腺癌を伴う悪性転化した奇形腫であった。原発巣の奇形腫成分を再検討したところ、後腹膜腫瘤と類似した組織像の腺癌が確認された。手術後の補助化学療法としてEAP療法(シスプラチン+エトポシド+ドキソルビシン)を2コース施行し、21か月間再発を認めず生存している。化学療法後の精巣がんに非胚細胞性悪性腫瘍を生じることは稀と考えられてきた。原発巣の胎児性癌と奇形腫、後腹膜の成熟奇形腫、および悪性転化を伴う後腹膜奇形腫のDNAフローサイトメトリー解析では、いずれも異数性腫瘍であった。(抄録は250語で打ち切られている)
